preconditions.description: The input string `s` must be a non-empty string.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(k, int) and k > 0 and n % k == 0
preconditions.description: The integer `k` must be a positive divisor of the string length `n`.
The variable `n` must equal the length of the string `s`.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_lines) == n // k for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly `n // k` lines, where `n` is the length of the input string `s`.

postconditions.expression: all(len(u_i) == len(set(t_i)) for u_i, t_i in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [s[i*k:(i+1)*k] for i in range(n // k)]))
postconditions.description: Each output line `u_i` must be a string with unique characters, derived from the corresponding substring `t_i` of length `k` in `s`.

postconditions.expression: all(all(u_i[j] in t_i and u_i[j] not in u_i[:j] for j in range(len(u_i))) for u_i, t_i in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [s[i*k:(i+1)*k] for i in range(n // k)]))
postconditions.description: Each character in `u_i` must appear in `t_i` in the same order as in `u_i`, and no character in `u_i` may repeat.
